title: Parallax stack
summary: An interface pulled apart into solid layers in depth; the camera orbits so each slides at its own speed, then they fall flat into one screen.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: depth
params.description: how far apart the layers float, 1 = default

params.name: thickness
params.description: how thick each component is, 0 for flat cards

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add parallax-stack --name my-parallax-stack
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-parallax-stack/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-parallax-stack/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: reveal how a product is built
an opener that turns flat into deep
